extension.summary: 雾汐｜轻量透明皮肤，专为 Emby for Kodi NextGen 优化，支持多评分展示
Mistuary - Lightweight transparent skin optimized for Emby for Kodi NextGen with multi-rating support
extension.description: 基于 Estuary N 改造，画面优先。原生适配 Emby for Kodi NextGen 动态节点，详情页直接展示豆瓣、IMDb、TMDB、烂番茄多源评分；保留透黑/透白双主题，页面、浮窗、播放透明度可调。

Estuary N based video-first skin. Natively compatible with Emby for Kodi NextGen dynamic nodes, displaying ratings from Douban, IMDb, TMDB and Rotten Tomatoes. Features dark & light transparent themes with adjustable transparency for pages, popups and playback overlay.
extension.disclaimer: Weather, radio and game browsing surfaces are intentionally omitted.
本皮肤有意省略天气、电台和游戏浏览界面；
